svg.title: Covenant — a cast of eight original people
svg.desc: Akari, Ren, Yuki, Kai, Mio, Nox, Sora, and Iona, with individual faces, clothes, and expressive human gestures.

g.text: COVENANT / THE PEOPLE BEHIND EVERY PROMISE
Eight lives. Different work. One shared promise to make.

svg.title: Akari — thinking carefully. A red ribbon and a pocket notebook.

svg.aria-label: Ren — explaining with an open hand
svg.title: Ren — explaining with an open hand. An ochre scarf and a copper lapel pin.
Yuki — resolute. Fine spectacles and a silver pen.
Kai — hopeful. Rolled sleeves and a well used pencil.
Mio — delighted. Golden drop earrings and a paint patch.
Nox — at ease. A silver hair clasp and a quiet seal.
Sora — worried. Tied hair and a little key charm.
Iona — surprised. A canvas delivery strap and a parcel patch.
